mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts rate above 1200 thousand units indicates robust residential construction activity, which typically precedes stronger consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when HOUST exceeds 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.1pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE falls >0.1pp and PAYEMS rises >50k in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase, a monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 0.5% signals expanding manufacturing output and improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises >0.5% during the post-recession recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals an overheating economy that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) indicates robust consumer spending and accommodative monetary conditions, which together support corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing and strong consumer spending
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS rises >0.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 annual growth > 2%), a monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and supply chain expansion, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO rises >0.5% during periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 annual growth > 2%).
